edge.mechanism: Transmission-station replacement, substation expansion, congestion relief, and resilience projects require high-voltage transformation equipment; sustained grid-modernization capital spending therefore consumes large-power-transformer production slots independently of new AI data-center connections.

evidence.summary: EIA reported 2023 utility transmission investment of $27.7 billion and distribution investment of $50.9 billion, with spending driven by aging-equipment replacement, resilience, renewable integration, and substation and transformer upgrades.
DOE announced $1.5 billion for four transmission projects intended to improve reliability and resilience, relieve congestion, and expand access to electricity supply.

DOE identified the addition of large power transformers to accommodate transmission expansion and economic growth as a primary demand driver, and described LPT supply-chain constraints as potential bottlenecks to rapid grid expansion.
